title: Vending
keymap.start: Vending robbery: break in, keep working or repair
begin.offline: The vending service isn't ready. Try again in a moment.
begin.unfit: You can't do that right now.
begin.spent: This machine has already been cleaned out.
begin.taken: Someone else is working this machine.
begin.cooldown: Lie low for another %d min before the next one.
begin.recent: This one was hit not long ago. Give it %d min.
begin.police: Too quiet out there. Needs %d officers on duty.
begin.away: Its owner isn't around. Leave it.
begin.tray: Someone just bought from it. Give it a moment.
begin.assets: The machine didn't load. Try again in a moment.
pry.slip: The bar slipped off the door.
pry.stuck: It's still holding. Give it a second.
pick.overset: Pushed it too far. Pins dropped.
pick.torque: Too much tension. The wrench slipped.
pick.jammed: The lock is jammed solid. Only a crowbar opens it now.
open.pick: The lock turns. The door is open.
open.pry: The door gives. The alarm is ringing.
box.seized: The cash box lock is wrecked. It isn't opening.
loot.cap: That's all you can haul out of one machine.
end.nothing: Nothing more you can get out of it.
end.locked: You can't get this lock open with what you have.
repair.done: Lock replaced for %s. The machine is back in service.
owner.title: Vending
owner.alarm: The door alarm on your %s is going off.
owner.robbed: Your %s was broken into. It stays out of order until it is repaired.
hint.pick: Hold tension in the band, then lift pins. Only one pin binds at a time: it lifts heavy. Stop where it bites.
hint.pry: Set the bar on a latch and pull down. Hold it in the band until it gives. This is loud.
hint.stacker: Grip the bill stacker on the door and pull it down off its rails.
hint.drill: Hold the drill on the cash box lock. Keep the heat in the band. Let it cool before it snaps.
hint.drawer: The box is open. Take the bundles.
hint.shelves: Hold on a product to keep pulling stock.
hud.boxkey: Pins 1 to 4 also open the cash box.
settings.light_desc: A small light on the lock or box you are working on.
